Reason: The ultrasound images show a multicystic mass in the fetal thorax with a systemic feeding vessel (indicated by color Doppler), which is characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM; such lower/middle lobe lesions typically cause mass effect, displacing the heart to the contralateral side and elevating the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm.
